description: FateCat control-plane registry. It reconciles existing infrastructure resources into a shared spec/status/admission/drift view.

admission.reason: production capabilities are executable through CapabilityExecutor; planned capabilities remain discoverable but blocked
admission.promotion: status can move to production only after testGate.status=passing, provider lifecycle metadata exists, and profile remains standalone unless bazi
admission.deprecation: capabilities must be removed through registry/profile/test updates, not hidden by front-end filtering

reconciliation.summary: Control-plane gate recomputes capability counts and default/planned/production admission rules from source registry.
reconciliation.driftPolicy: fail if counts, default capability, production test gates, planned engine/provider or markdown default drift

metadata.risk: A pass proves registry alignment only; it does not prove prediction accuracy.
metadata.privacyBoundary: No user input, report body, token, secret or DSN is read.

desiredState.coverage: one production provider for each production capability provider id

admission.reason: providers are executable only when their owning production capability is executable
admission.promotion: provider lifecycle gate must pass before a provider can support production capability promotion
admission.deprecation: provider deprecation requires replacementProvider or removalNotBefore in provider metadata

gate.scope: provider metadata, lifecycle, source, license, manifest, promotion and deprecation

reconciliation.summary: Control-plane gate compares runtime providers with production capabilities and delegates depth checks to provider lifecycle gate.
reconciliation.driftPolicy: fail if provider count, provider id coverage or provider lifecycle gate drifts

metadata.risk: Provider health is in-process unless externalConnectivity evidence exists in downstream gates.
metadata.privacyBoundary: No production credential, user report, external API payload or private DSN is read.

desiredState.shipGatePolicy: live shipGate remains blocked until all required external evidence is present

admission.reason: release gate is an operator gate, not a user-executable calculation capability
admission.promotion: live release can pass only when required evidence has real external proof
admission.deprecation: release evidence categories must be retired through release-gate schema and tests

gate.scope: release evidence categories, shipGate policy and current-release-proof contract

reconciliation.summary: Contract is available; live shipGate remains blocked until external API/HF/Bot/registry/rollback evidence is present.
reconciliation.driftPolicy: fail if required evidence count, shipGate, privacy boundary or external verification entries drift

metadata.risk: Local control-plane pass does not mean production live release is allowed.
metadata.privacyBoundary: No GitHub token, registry token, production log, user input or report body is stored.

admission.reason: EvaluationRun resources are executable through whitelisted commands only
admission.promotion: new evaluation runs must declare datasetIds, commands, releaseRequired and lastKnownStatusPolicy
admission.deprecation: retired evaluation runs must be removed with downstream dashboard/trend gates updated

gate.scope: evaluation registry, dataset links, command whitelist and last-known-status policy

reconciliation.summary: Control-plane gate checks dataset/run counts, required run ids and evaluation-only boundaries.
reconciliation.driftPolicy: fail if dataset/run count, required run ids, dataset links or releaseRequired policy drift

metadata.risk: Evaluation registry does not store current benchmark results and must not feed benchmark answers into production.
metadata.privacyBoundary: No benchmark answer text, report body, user data or external credential is stored.
Control-plane registry stores only paths, policies and status summaries; it does not store secrets, DSN, tokens, production logs, user birth data or report bodies.
